items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tony Taylor’s sister and I took up and…

ctx.x: Yeah, but Tony Taylor’s sister and I took up and…who owned the club, one of the owners or whatever. And he didn’t want his sisters to be involved with jazz musician. I was over there, sitting on the porch after they closed the club and he said, “what are you doing here!” and all this other stuff. That meant that I wasn’t going to be playing there much longer. I left to go to Detroit and she followed me so that really did it. I was a booger in his eyesight.
Didn’t you and Benny both end up…
